verdict_text:
YES

The plan verifies the three checkpoints against each other before any mutation (160-tensor counts on `ft1`/`ft2`, plus element-wise `equal` of every non-MLP tensor of `base` against `ft1` and `ft2` via the negative-lookahead pattern), which together with the later 48-count asserts also pins the name sets to be identical. Both task vectors are materialized as temporary `.tv1`/`.tv2` tensors and scaled by 0.4 *before* either is added back, so each is taken against the unmodified base as clause 2 requires, and the two `add_` steps produce `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)` in float32. The three required checks are present as `assert` transforms (shared-tensor equality, 48 merged tensors per task vector, 160 tensors in the output), the temporaries are deleted before the final count, non-MLP tensors are never written, and the output path matches `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
